name: receipt-printer
title: Receipt Printer
description: Confirm a payment, watch the thermal receipt print and print another copy.
usage: <ReceiptPrinter merchant="Studio" order={{ id: "S-12", description: "Print", amount: 32, currency: "EUR" }} />
useCases: After checkout, a shop shows a receipt with the order ID returned by its server. The buyer can print that confirmed receipt again.
In a point-of-sale prototype, a designer runs a demo purchase and shows the receipt without connecting a payment service.
task: Print a receipt after payment confirmation.
behavior: Omitting onPay enables demo checkout. Supply order.amount in major currency units. Resolve onPay with { orderId } after server confirmation. Rejection enables retry. Reprinting reuses the saved receipt.
